prompts.hand-press-upleft.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single original 3D cartoon hand sprite for pressing buttons in a video. Square 1024x1024 PNG, genuinely fully transparent background. One isolated soft clay-style RIGHT HAND, smooth rounded chubby fingers, warm peach skin, matte soft studio shading, a short periwinkle purple-blue sleeve with a clean white cuff. INDEX FINGER extended and pointing diagonally UP-LEFT at precisely45 degrees in the image plane. Other three fingers curled naturally into palm, thumb tucked, anatomically coherent exactly five digits total. Sleeve/wrist at LOWER RIGHT. Back/three-quarter side of hand visible, friendly 3D hand emoji/icon aesthetic, original design, not a copy of stock. Soft large studio light from upper-left, subtle self-shading only. All parts fully inside the square with generous transparent padding, hand fills about75% of frame diagonal. No button, no environment, no ground plane, no cast/background shadow, no glow, no text, no numbers, no watermark or logos. Keep a clean silhouette and an easily identifiable rounded fingertip at the upper-left end for precise button-contact anchoring.
